title: DOS-UAP-D001, Diplomatic Cable, Brazil, November 14, 1963
doc_notes: This document is a U.S. Department of State diplomatic cable regarding the verification of a local newspaper report about a crashed balloon in Brazil.

incidents.summary: Local newspaper report of a large metal manned balloon crash near Salvador, Brazil, with a dead crewman in a spacesuit.
incidents.explanation: The Department of State assessed the report as inauthentic and no object was found.
incidents.quote: large metal manned balloon had been found vicinity Salvador

incidents.summary: Sighting of an object identified as a weather-type balloon in the vicinity of Salvador.
incidents.explanation: Tentatively identified as a weather-type balloon.
incidents.quote: object had been sighted in that vicinity around that date
